programs.name: Example App (Caddy - Prefix Aware)
programs.comment: Caddy integration: url field creates reverse proxy. URL_PREFIX makes app prefix-aware. PUBLIC_BASE auto-injected.

programs.name: Example App (Caddy - Strip Prefix)
programs.comment: Caddy strips /app2 prefix before forwarding to app (uses handle_path). App sees requests at root path.

programs.name: Example App (Direct Access - No Caddy)
programs.comment: No url field = no Caddy integration. URL auto-generated as http://<detected-ip>:8001 for direct access.

programs.name: Example App (Manual URL Override)
programs.comment: Manual URL overrides auto-generation. Useful for external domains or custom configurations.

programs.name: Example Application 3 (No URL)
programs.comment: No PORT env var and no URL, so no clickable link will appear
